data.title: Josh Goyne Named Chief Executive Officer of Branch
data.description: A highly experienced construction executive with over 25 years of infrastructure and operational leadership background has joined the Roanoke, Virginia-based employee-owned company. Branch, an employee-owned construction firm operating in the Mid-Atlantic region, offers a wide range of services.

data.title: Gravitate Publishes Research Series on AI Search Visibility as Answer Engine Optimization Becomes a Board-Level Priority
data.description: Gravitate, a Portland agency, has released four new guides focusing on various digital marketing topics. The guides cover LLM SEO, AI readability, budget reallocation, and provide 33 daily methods for ranking in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. Established 27 years ago, Gravitate is a prominent player in the digital marketing and web industry in Portland. These new guides aim to assist businesses in understanding and implementing effective strategies in the ever-evolving digital landscape.

data.title: San Miguel Sotheby's International Realty and Querétaro Sotheby's International Realty Celebrate 50 Years of Sotheby's International Realty
data.description: A recent event in San Miguel de Allende, Mexico and Querétaro, Mexico saw San Miguel Sotheby's International Realty and Querétaro Sotheby's International Realty come together to mark Sotheby's International Realty's 50th anniversary. The celebration included an intimate cocktail gathering. This event was part of the global recognition of Sotheby's International Realty's milestone, highlighting its long-standing presence in the industry.

data.title: Matan Companies Signs Two New Industrial Leases Totaling More Than 92,000 SF in Frederick, MD
data.description: In Frederick, Maryland, on August 21, 2026, Matan Companies has confirmed the finalization of two extended industrial lease agreements covering a combined area exceeding 92,000 square feet. This development underscores the robustness of the area's industrial sector and the persistent high demand for industrial spaces.

data.title: Terrance Bradford Construction in Tampa Florida Expands Construction Consultation Services Throughout the Tampa Area
data.description: A construction company based in Tampa, Florida, Terrance Bradford Construction, revealed the launch of its expanded construction consultation services on August 21, 2026. The company is set to provide enhanced consultation services to its clients in the region.

data.title: Atlanta Braves Games to Air in Spanish on  Gray Media’s Telemundo Affiliate Stations Across the Southeast
data.description: Atlanta Braves enthusiasts in the Southeast will have the opportunity to view two Braves games in Spanish via 18 Telemundo Affiliate Stations. This initiative signifies a significant step towards enhancing accessibility, reaching a wider audience, and promoting inclusivity in sports broadcasting. The coverage will be available in multiple regions and is expected to resonate with a diverse demographic of fans.

data.title: Greenland Government Approves Rare Earths License Transfer to Greenland Mines
data.description: Approval from regulatory authorities has been secured, marking a crucial step towards finalizing the acquisition of the Sarfartoq Nd-Pr Rare Earths Project. This approval fulfills a significant closing requirement for the acquisition deal. The project involves the extraction and processing of Nd-Pr rare earths, essential elements in various industries. The acquisition has progressed successfully with this development, bringing the project closer to completion.
